title: banchi: T7 checks that cannot run as root or without IPv6 report a named SKIP
why: Owner ask ask-mw6vybwdb8 part 2, 14:58 CST Nov 7. Six T7 checks cannot pass in a Claude Code cloud VM (measured 2026-11-02 on banchi main b86f621): 4 read-only-door checks in harness/tests/t7/store_core.py chmod a folder 0555, which root ignores; 2 dual-stack bind checks need IPv6, which the VM kernel lacks (errno 97).
note: The owner's ask names his pick: each reports a named SKIP when euid is 0 or IPv6 is absent, counted by scripts/ci-skip-count.sh, never a pass; CI is non-root with IPv6, so CI is unchanged. The ask also says to bring the options to the owner first, because it changes what a test proves: the lane files that question with his pick as the recommendation before it builds. Repo banchi. Owner pick a on page item 375 (banchi-t7-cloud-skip), 19:03 CST Nov 7: a named SKIP in the cloud. Owner note: "i wonder if t7 is accurately needed". The lane answers whether the T7 checks earn their place. Lane 19:20 CST: pick a counted, build started on branch t7-cloud-skip. T7 is needed: 646 checks, the only test reaching store/, server/ and cli/; the 3 checks each guard a recorded incident. CI cost 2.6-4.2 min per shard (main run 87); the cloud VM ran T7 over 25 min without finishing (15:01-15:26 CST).
